title: Life Skills (Do's and Don'ts)
parentNote: This unit covers good manners, safety rules, and social skills. Very important for everyday life!
learnBullets: Know about **good manners** and polite behaviour
Learn **safety rules** at home and outside
Understand **do's and don'ts** in different situations
learnItFirst:
**1. Good Manners (Magic Words)**

| When | Say |
|------|-----|
| Asking for something | Please 🙏 |
| Receiving something | Thank you 😊 |
| Making a mistake | Sorry 😔 |
| Meeting someone | Hello/Namaste 🙏 |
| Leaving | Goodbye/Bye |

**2. Safety Do's and Don'ts**

✅ **Do's:**
- Look left and right before crossing the road
- Tell parents where you are going
- Wash hands before eating
- Wear helmet while cycling
- Say no to strangers offering food or rides

❌ **Don'ts:**
- Don't play with fire or sharp objects
- Don't touch electrical switches with wet hands
- Don't take medicines without parents' permission
- Don't share personal information with strangers
- Don't bully others

**3. Being a Good Person**

- Always tell the **truth**
- **Share** with others
- Be **kind** to everyone
- **Help** those in need
- **Respect** elders and teachers

questions.content: What should you say when someone gives you a gift?
questions.why: We should always say 'Thank you' when receiving something

questions.content: What should you say when you want something?
questions.why: We should say 'Please' when asking for something

questions.content: If you hurt someone by mistake, you should say ___.
questions.why: We should say 'Sorry' when we make a mistake or hurt someone

questions.content: Should you take sweets from strangers?
questions.why: Never take food or sweets from strangers — say no and tell your parents

questions.content: Before eating food, we should ___.
questions.why: Always wash hands before eating to stay healthy

questions.content: What should you do when an elder enters the room?
questions.why: We should greet elders with respect (Namaste/Hello)

questions.content: If a stranger asks you to come with them, what should you do?

options.A: Say no and tell your parents

questions.why: Never go with strangers — say no firmly and tell your parents or a trusted adult

questions.content: Telling lies is ___.
questions.why: Telling lies is bad — always speak the truth

questions.content: You should ___ your toys with friends.
questions.why: Sharing with friends is a good habit

questions.content: When you sneeze or cough, you should ___.
questions.why: Cover your mouth and nose when sneezing or coughing to prevent spreading germs

questions.content: Should you touch electrical switches with wet hands?
questions.why: Never touch electrical switches with wet hands — you can get an electric shock

questions.content: If you find a wallet on the road, what should you do?

options.B: Try to return it or give to an adult

questions.why: If you find something, try to return it to the owner or give it to a trusted adult

questions.content: Bullying other children is ___.
questions.why: Bullying is wrong — we should be kind to everyone

questions.content: You should ___ when the national anthem is being sung.
questions.why: We should stand respectfully and silently when the national anthem is sung

questions.content: If someone is feeling sad, what should you do?

options.B: Try to help and be kind

questions.why: We should be kind and try to help when someone is sad

questions.content: Should you play with fire or matchsticks?
questions.why: Never play with fire or matchsticks — it's very dangerous

questions.content: You see a classmate being bullied. What should you do?
questions.why: If you see bullying, tell a teacher or trusted adult immediately

questions.content: When someone is speaking, we should ___.
questions.why: Good manners mean listening quietly when someone is speaking

questions.content: You should take medicine ___.
questions.why: Never take medicines without your parents' or doctor's permission

questions.content: If you accidentally break something, what should you do?
questions.why: Always tell the truth — honesty is the best policy

questions.content: When waiting in line (queue), you should ___.
questions.why: We should wait patiently for our turn in a queue

questions.content: Wasting food is ___.
questions.why: Wasting food is bad — take only what you can eat

questions.content: If you see garbage on the floor, you should ___.

options.B: Pick it up and put it in the dustbin

questions.why: We should keep our surroundings clean by putting garbage in the dustbin

questions.content: Helping others makes us feel ___.
questions.why: Helping others is a kind act that makes us and others happy

questions.content: You should ___ before entering someone's room.
questions.why: Good manners mean knocking and waiting before entering someone's room

sections.name: Achiever's Corner
sections.leadingContext: Think carefully about these life skill situations!

questions.content: Your friend forgot their lunch. What should you do?
questions.why: We should help our friends — sharing shows kindness

questions.content: If you are lost in a market, what should you do?

options.A: Stay calm and ask a shopkeeper or police for help
options.C: Go with any stranger who offers help

questions.why: Stay calm and ask a trusted adult like a shopkeeper or police officer for help

questions.content: Making fun of someone because they are different is ___.
questions.why: We should never make fun of anyone — everyone deserves respect

questions.content: If you see an old person struggling to carry bags, you should ___.
questions.why: We should always help elderly people — it shows respect and kindness

questions.content: Being honest even when it's difficult is ___.
questions.why: Being honest, even when it's hard, is brave and the right thing to do
